verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-streaming and remote-control app. A built-in AI assistant is a capability such a product could plausibly ship, so the axis applies. The evidence covers streaming, input, pairing, connectivity and installation, but never mentions any AI assistant or task delegation, so the verdict is none.
